page_results.notes: Architectural floor plan A01 shows a 16.00 x 12.00 ground-floor envelope. Measurement convention printed: floor areas to wall centrelines, do not deduct wall strips. Rooms G01–G09 are tagged; most have printed areas. G05 Hall has no printed area; I inferred 24.00 m2 from the dimensioned 2.00 m central band running the full 12.00 m height, with the stair shown as a 4.00 x 4.00 square located in the bottom-right bay (outside the 2.00 m hall band). If the stair encroaches into the 2.00 m band, the hall would reduce accordingly by 8.00 m2; please verify on A01/A03. Opening sizes are not given on this page; therefore door_area and window_area are set to 0. Wall lengths/areas for internal partitions are not fully dimensioned; only the overall perimeter is certain. This is a preliminary AI takeoff and must be reviewed by a quantity surveyor.

document_measurement_review.notes:
geometry: Ground floor geometry is fully closed with all tagged rooms, using wall-centreline coordinates: x splits at 0, 7, 9, 13, 16; y splits at 0, 4, 8, 12. First floor is partially closed: VOID and terrace polygons are fixed by A04 coordinates (VOID x=10..13, y=0..4) and the terrace orientation evidenced by railing lengths and plan tags. F08/F09 internal boundary lacks a printed dimension; no artificial closure was forced.
structure: All quantities are taken from the declared structural schedule S01 and bar schedule S02 with measurement rules from A04. Beam volumes and beam formwork use only the 0.25 m downstand to avoid duplication with slab concrete/soffit. Slab formwork covers only suspended first and roof slabs; beam soffits are already included in slab soffit per A04.
surfaces: Walls: external 200 mm, internal 120 mm, height 3.20 m per p6. Wet rooms and heights per p6; only wet floor areas are sourced because room perimeters are not provided for wet wall calculations. Roof net area uses S01 terrace omission. Terrace area is 12 m2 on p2. External wall length counted once for project, to avoid double-counting across floors.
inventory: Door_count includes Type=door only per A03; garage_door_count is reported separately. Window/door areas use scheduled width x height; sill heights not used for area. Services, pipe lengths and external works are taken directly from M01. Scope IDs reflect floors or project totals as stated. All sources are R1 revision.

silently switch to clear-net floor areas.

y=0..4. Terrace is entered through FD08 on its north boundary.
WALLS: external 200 mm; internal 120 mm; clear height 3.20 m. Masonry measured by NET face area: length x height, minus
full door/window openings. Transfer terrace-facing partitions into external wall class.

excludes wet wall tiles and kitchen backsplash.

floor finish; terrace is outdoor tile and has no internal ceiling.

WATERPROOFING: roof excludes open terrace; terrace is a separate line. No parapet upstands or wastage in this synthetic
